title: World cron one-shot delivery state
description: Interface-private receipt at OCTOPUS_VAR_DIR/one-shot/<due_unix_ns>.json. A prepared receipt is not admission proof. An admitted receipt requires the exact InterfaceArrival ledger row at admitted_seq, from this exact interface, carrying artifact id artifact_label:manifest_hash. Completion means time-artifact admission, not completion of the receiving task. An admitted occurrence has no next due time or recurrence.

due_unix_ns.description: Exact Unix nanoseconds parsed from schedule.due_at, encoded as a decimal string for lossless JavaScript reads; also the receipt filename stem. Do not convert through Number.
